rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines side work that is clearly small, low-risk, routine, or mechanical (searching, reading logs, running tests), and a fast low-cost model can complete it without compromising the task.
rules.why: Cheapest current tier: GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash (omp roles in ~/.omp/agent/config.yml). Quota decides the family; omp's auto classifier sets effort.

rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines a clear, scoped fix or change of moderate size: the path and the acceptance evidence are both already clear.
rules.why: Mid tier: GPT-6.1 Terra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Antigravity Claude Sonnet 5.5.

rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines high complexity, uncertainty, or blast radius in a bounded task: cross-cutting design, security, concurrency, release-critical changes, or a review the owner asked for.
rules.why: High tier: GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Antigravity Claude Opus 5.5.

rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines a big, ambiguous job expected to run for hours: the goal is clear but the path is not, and the work spans many files, systems, or decisions.
rules.why: Frontier tier: Claude Fable 5.2 or GPT-6 Astra, whichever subscription has quota, at high effort for the long run (owner direction, 11 November 2026). Plan the job at medium effort before dispatching it.
